title: vuhive Configuration Schema
description: Official JSON Schema for vuhive declarative load testing configuration files (vuhive.yaml).

default_scenario.description: Name of the scenario to execute by default when no --scenario CLI flag is supplied.

scenarios.description: Map of named load testing scenarios to their execution profiles.

duration.description: Go duration string with time unit (e.g. 500ms, 10s, 1m, 2m30s, 1h).

stage.description: A single stage in a ramping_vus multi-stage load profile.

target.description: Target number of Virtual Users (VUs) at the end of the stage.

duration.description: Duration over which to linearly ramp or hold the target VU count.

think_time.description: Delay distribution strategy configuration for simulated user pauses.

type.description: Delay distribution algorithm: 'fixed' (static pause), 'range' (uniform random between min/max), 'expo' (Poisson exponential distribution), 'gaussian' (normal distribution).

min.description: Minimum duration (required for 'range'; optional lower bound clamp for 'expo' and 'gaussian').

max.description: Maximum duration (required for 'range'; optional upper bound clamp for 'expo' and 'gaussian').

mean.description: Average delay duration (required for 'expo' and 'gaussian' strategies).

metric.description: Exact metric identifier as recorded during test execution (e.g. 'vuhive.http.req_duration', 'vuhive.kafka.pub_duration', 'vuhive.vu.iterations_failed').

stat.description: Statistical aggregation to evaluate against target.

operator.description: Comparison operator to evaluate actual stat against target.

target.description: Threshold target value (parsed as duration for p50-p99/mean/max, or as float64 for count/rate/value).

on_no_data.description: Evaluation strategy when no metric data is recorded during the test run: 'zero' (evaluates unrecorded metrics with value 0; default for count/value), 'fail' (fails threshold evaluation with 'no data'; default for duration/rate), 'pass' (marks threshold as passed if no data is present), 'ignore'/'skip' (ignores threshold when no data is present).

abort_on_fail.description: If true, aborts test execution immediately upon threshold breach during active runtime.

delay_abort_eval.description: Warm-up grace period before active abort_on_fail evaluations begin.

http_config.description: Declarative HTTP client transport, connection pooling, headers, and TLS configuration.

base_url.description: Base target URL prepended to relative request paths.

timeout.description: Per-request timeout for HTTP client requests.

headers.description: Default HTTP headers sent with every request.

insecure_skip_verify.description: Disables TLS certificate verification (for self-signed testing).

max_idle_conns.description: Maximum number of idle (keep-alive) connections across all hosts.

max_idle_conns_per_host.description: Maximum number of idle (keep-alive) connections per host.

idle_conn_timeout.description: Maximum duration an idle connection remains in the pool.

detailed_timing.description: Enables collection of detailed per-phase HTTP timing metrics via net/http/httptrace.

metric_prefix.description: Custom prefix for auto-recorded HTTP metrics (defaults to 'vuhive.http.').

scenario.description: Scenario load profile and pacing configuration.

type.description: Execution model: 'constant_vus' (closed-system concurrent VUs), 'arrival_rate' (open-system TPS pacing), or 'ramping_vus' (multi-stage ramping profile).

vus.description: Number of concurrent Virtual Users (required for 'constant_vus').

max_vus.description: Hard cap on concurrent worker goroutines (required for 'arrival_rate').

burst_buffer.description: Bounded queue depth for arrival_rate token dispatch. Absorbs transient worker availability fluctuations before dropping tokens. When 0 (default), auto-sized to max(2 × target_tps, max_vus).

stages.description: List of stages defining the multi-stage ramping load profile (required for 'ramping_vus').

ramp_up.description: Duration to linearly ramp up load to steady state.

ramp_down.description: Duration for graceful ramp-down / active scaling down of load.

drain.description: Dedicated grace period allowing in-flight VUs to terminate cleanly before teardown.

drain_period.description: Alias for drain: dedicated grace period allowing in-flight VUs to terminate cleanly before teardown.

params.description: Key-value parameters made available to test code via ctx.Param(), ctx.ParamInt(), or ctx.ParamDuration().

interaction_delay.description: Thinking time strategy evaluated by ctx.Sleep() when called with no arguments.

think_time.description: Inter-iteration pacing delay automatically executed by the engine loop between iterations.

thresholds.description: List of SLA threshold assertions to evaluate.

http.description: Declarative HTTP client configuration (base_url, timeout, headers, TLS, connection pool, timing).

http_clients.description: Map of named HTTP client configurations allowing Virtual Users to target multiple distinct base URLs and services.
